text.p: The week-old bureau of the finance ministry team of 'untouchables' has made an impressive start in tackling fiscal- and customs-related tax evasion.

"SDOE (acronym for Bureau of Economic Crime) has started its operations a week earlier and its systematic and effective inspections has yielded substantial fiscal results." deputy finance minister Georgios Drys told parliament on Friday.
The 'untouchables' run 3,474 inspections, registering 4,433 breaches of fiscal and customs regulations within the first week of the bureau's operations.
Fifteen cases have already been sent to courts.
"It is therefore obvious from the number of inspections and regulation breaches that the message has been conveyed to the business world" Drys said. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301-3311812-4
